description: What the text editor host syncs into its session when a scene arrives. An echo of the editor's own edit (external = false) carries back its text, its selection and the paged-carrier lane ref of the buffer (bytes + FNV-1a/64 hash of the text); none of them may reach the session again, every other field must. `echo` is the scene that arrives after `previous`; `synced` is the canonical editor scene document (the typed pack: buffer, selection, tokens, diagnostics, placeholders, occurrences, extraCarets, selectableSpans, settings, camera, overlays, hover) the session receives for it, decoded; `samePack` says whether the host may skip the sync (byte-identical pack, so no repaint). The lane refs are the ones a writer echo carried live (ticket 26/09/23 F3): FNV-1a/64 of "" = cbf29ce484222325, of "a" = af63dc4c8601ec8c; lane refs and `language` are scene transport and display members, never members of the canonical document, so no lane (declared or not, the `outline` lane stands in for any other) ever enters the pack.
